question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is, '**several**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Several** means **some.** 

 
 
• Example - ***She likes this store, so now she is buying several things***.
 
 
 
• There is used for more than two, but not many.
